==Acquisition==
'''[[Signet of Capture]]'''
*[[Prophecies]]
**[[Abaddon's Cursed]] ([[Perdition Rock]]) (requires a party member to be carrying a [[Proof of Triumph]])

Note that as a [[List of PvE-only skills|PvE-only]] skill, [[Elite Skill Tome|Elite Skill Tomes]] cannot be used to learn this skill.

==Notes==
* Usually combined with [[Dark Aura]] for [[AoE]] [[armor-ignoring]] damage.
** [[Live Vicariously]] can help offset the health loss of Dark Aura.
* The health sacrifice occurs for each hit rather than for each attack, so skills such as [[Cyclone Axe]] or [[Whirlwind Attack]] can trigger the health sacrifice multiple times, while skills such as [[Vigorous Spirit]] will trigger once, and [[Illusionary Weaponry]] will not trigger it at all.
** [[Blood Bond]] can help offset the health sacrifice.
** This can lead to a [[spike]] when combined with Dark Aura.
* The health sacrifice occurs even if the attack [[miss]]es or is [[block]]ed.
* The concise description is correct: the damage is [[armor-ignoring]] bonus damage.

{{anomaly|The health sacrifice does not appear on the damage monitor.}}

==Trivia==
* This is the only ability that sacrifices a flat amount of health.
*This skill uses the same icon as the ''[[Guild Wars 2]]'' [[gw2:Necromancer|Necromancer]] skill [[gw2:Dark Path|Dark Path]].
*Added to the game with the [[Feedback:Game updates/20200422|22nd April 2020 update]] as part of the 15th [[Anniversary Celebration]].
*Prior to the 30th April 2020 patch, life sacrifice also triggered if the attack missed or failed, leading to Dark Aura triggering twice on [[Dual attack]]s out of sequence. 
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
